question: What level of secrecy characterizes the supreme teaching declared to the goddess?
premises: The speaker directly addresses the goddess.
A teaching has been declared to the addressee.
The declared teaching is more secret than the secret.
The declared teaching is characterized as supreme.
inference: Thus a supreme teaching, surpassing even the secret in secrecy, has been communicated to the goddess.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the preceding teaching summarized by iti is not specified within this verse.
plain_english: Thus, O goddess, what is more secret than the secret, the supreme, has been told to you.
